secondaries.name: Guardian of the Realm
secondaries.text: At the end of every phase, in either player's turn, score 1 victory point if your SHIELD-CAPTAIN model destroyed an enemy model during that phase, or 2 victory points instead if any unit it destroyed a model of was within range of an objective marker when the phase began. At most 2 victory points per phase. Kills by other models do not count.

secondaries.name: Drive the Talons Deep
secondaries.text: From round 2, at the end of your opponent's turn, score 3 victory points if at least one of your ADEPTUS CUSTODES units that is not Battle-shocked has every model wholly inside your opponent's deployment zone. The award is flat, however many units qualify.
